episodes.title: Lv1: How the World Works
episodes.summary: Despite his best efforts, level 999 villager Kagami gets involved in a quest to hunt the Demon King.

episodes.title: Lv2: The Ultimate Idiot
episodes.summary: Kagami agrees to help Alice and introduces her to a friend.

episodes.title: Lv3: Demon and Human Coexistence
episodes.summary: Kagami foils a demonic attack on the city and learns about darker forces at play.

episodes.title: Lv4: I Have Questions for You
episodes.summary: As monsters attack Salmaria, the Hero's party begins to doubt their convictions.

episodes.title: Lv5: Assigned Roles
episodes.summary: The battle for Salmaria seems to be going well, until an unexpected visitor drops in.

episodes.title: Lv6: Her Highness's Thinking
episodes.summary: Kagami and his friends kick off a new adventure: trying to start a casino in Valman!

episodes.title: Lv7: You're Changed by the People You Meet
episodes.summary: An unexpected new ally has contributed to the casino's opening, but trouble is brewing behind the scenes.

episodes.title: Lv8: Incompatible
episodes.summary: While Kagami and Menow pursue a quicker way to earn money, Alice struggles with suspicions back in Valman.

episodes.title: Lv9: Hope Like Never Before
episodes.summary: At the end of a mysterious dungeon, Kagami and Menow learn more than they expected.

episodes.title: Lv10: I'll Destroy It
episodes.summary: The heroes regroup and plot their next course of action in light of recent events.

episodes.title: Lv11: The King's Authority Is Absolute
episodes.summary: Kagami and friends storm the castle to try to negotiate with the king, but find Parna waiting for them.

episodes.title: Lv12: Damned Ideas of Common Sense
episodes.summary: Kagami makes a last-ditch offer to save his friends and right the wrongs in the world.
